package ext

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	yaml2 "gopkg.in/yaml.v2"
	yaml3 "gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
)

func TestRuleSegmentYAML(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, input, operator string
		keys                  []string
		invalid               bool
	}{
		{name: "string", input: "segment: foo", keys: []string{"foo"}, operator: "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
		{name: "single object", input: "segment: {keys: [foo], operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR}", keys: []string{"foo"}, operator: "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
		{name: "multiple object", input: "segment: {keys: [foo, bar], operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR}", keys: []string{"foo", "bar"}, operator: "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
		{name: "missing", input: "rank: 1", invalid: true},
		{name: "empty", input: "segment: ''", invalid: true},
		{name: "list", input: "segment: [foo, bar]", invalid: true},
		{name: "empty keys", input: "segment: {keys: [], operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR}", invalid: true},
		{name: "no operator", input: "segment: {keys: [foo, bar]}", invalid: true},
		{name: "invalid operator", input: "segment: {keys: [foo, bar], operator: BAD}", invalid: true},
		{name: "extra property", input: "segment: {keys: [foo], operator: OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR, other: value}", invalid: true},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			for _, codec := range []struct {
				name   string
				decode func([]byte, interface{}) error
			}{
				{"v2", yaml2.Unmarshal}, {"v3", yaml3.Unmarshal},
			} {
				t.Run(codec.name, func(t *testing.T) {
					var rule Rule
					err := codec.decode([]byte(tc.input), &rule)
					if tc.invalid {
						if err == nil {
							_, _, err = rule.Segment.Values()
						}
						require.Error(t, err)
						return
					}
					require.NoError(t, err)
					keys, operator, err := rule.Segment.Values()
					require.NoError(t, err)
					require.Equal(t, tc.keys, keys)
					require.Equal(t, tc.operator, operator)
				})
			}
		})
	}
}
